description: This file defines an enumeration for different types of transactions that can occur on a SavingsAccount within the Apache Fineract project. It includes transaction types, associated properties, and helper methods to identify transaction characteristics.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionType
classes.description: Enumeration of various transaction types for SavingsAccount with helper methods to identify transaction nature and properties.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value representing the transaction type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: getEntryType
methods.description: Returns the TransactionEntryType (CREDIT or DEBIT) associated with the transaction type, if present.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding SavingsAccountTransactionType, returns INVALID if unrecognized.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is valid (not INVALID).

methods.name: isDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is DEPOSIT.

methods.name: isWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is WITHDRAWAL.

methods.name: isInterestPosting
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is INTEREST_POSTING.

methods.name: isOverDraftInterestPosting
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is OVERDRAFT_INTEREST.

methods.name: isWithHoldTax
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is WITHHOLD_TAX.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is WITHDRAWAL_FEE.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is ANNUAL_FEE.

methods.name: isPayCharge
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is PAY_CHARGE.

methods.name: isChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is any charge (pay, withdrawal fee, or annual fee).

methods.name: isWaiveCharge
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is WAIVE_CHARGES.

methods.name: isTransferInitiation
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is INITIATE_TRANSFER.

methods.name: isTransferApproval
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is APPROVE_TRANSFER.

methods.name: isTransferRejection
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is REJECT_TRANSFER.

methods.name: isTransferWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is WITHDRAW_TRANSFER.

methods.name: isWrittenoff
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is WRITTEN_OFF.

methods.name: isDividendPayout
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is DIVIDEND_PAYOUT.

methods.name: isIncomeFromInterest
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is OVERDRAFT_INTEREST, representing income from interest.

methods.name: isEscheat
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is ESCHEAT.

methods.name: isAmountOnHold
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is AMOUNT_HOLD.

methods.name: isAmountRelease
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is AMOUNT_RELEASE.

methods.name: isAccrual
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is ACCRUAL.

methods.name: isCredit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a credit entry, excluding AMOUNT_RELEASE from the credit check.

methods.name: isDebit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a debit entry, excluding AMOUNT_HOLD and ESCHEAT from the debit check.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Returns a list of transaction types filtered by the provided predicate.
